history.content: ok so i dont really know what this is supposed to do but here goes. things have been weirdly calm with me and my partner lately and im not used to it
“Weirdly calm” feels like the centre of this. I’m wondering if it’s a calm that feels safe, or one that feels a bit unfamiliar?
both i guess. its nice but i keep waiting for the other shoe to drop. we used to fight a lot. now we just... dont
That sounds like calm and watchfulness sitting together, with the old fighting still in the room. Is the watchfulness more like waiting, or more like bracing?

less bracing now actually. it was bracing for a while. we did couples counseling for like 4 months and i think it just worked? we worked out a thing where we take a break before either of us gets heated. its boring but it works

I’m hearing a calm that’s become more real, and a kind of “it worked” relief underneath the boredom. The waiting for the other shoe to drop seems to have loosened as the fighting stopped being the default.
yeah relief is the word. i didnt think wed make it past last year if im honest. it feels weird to trust the quiet but i think im starting to
“Trust the quiet” feels like the newest part here. I’m wondering if this quiet also means safety now, or if it still feels a little unfamiliar?
safety yeah. coming home doesnt feel like walking into a minefield anymore. thats the main thing. ok this was more useful than i expected honestly

“Walking into a minefield” is the image that lands, and now home sounds more like safety than bracing. We can leave it here, or if you want, I can stay with what changed so the quiet started to feel safe.
nah lets leave it there. dont wanna overthink a good thing for once. thanks though, this was alright
Glad it could be that, and I’ll leave the good thing untouched. Take care of the quiet.
